lens: search strategy, hidden-talent recall, query diversity, and sourcing coverage
strengths: The homepage keeps sourcing outside this relationship-momentum demonstration instead of implying that a conversation tool discovers or matches candidates.
Navigation, metadata, and sitemap copy make no candidate-ranking, profile-completeness, culture-fit, or acceptance-prediction claim.
The FAQ explicitly separates work-attention ordering from judging a person's quality.
missing_evidence: No sourcing query, result set, talent map, recall benchmark, or outreach experiment exists in the reviewed artifact.
open_questions: If sourcing is introduced later, what separate workflow and coverage test will prevent momentum signals from narrowing discovery?
